// Role Buffer packages. Edit freely, then run: python tools/buffer/build_buffer_data.py
// It checks that every id is a known buff, that no two skills in a package share a stack type (the second would
// replace the first), and that a package fits the slots: 20 buffs and 12 dances/songs (config/Player.ini).
//
// [key] Name | What it's for | icon=<skill id>
// then one skill id per line, most important first. Text after the id is only a note; the buffer always gives the
// skill's highest level. The [pet] package goes on your pet or summon when "Buff my pet" is on.
// The roles are shown in this order.
